examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A console mock in the framed panel with three tabs; the scene slot receives the selected tab. The bottom fifth is cropped and faded from the medium breakpoint up.

examples.name: Diagram
examples.summary: `kind="diagram"` lets the scene keep its own height, centered on the texture, with an action under the title instead of tabs.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ConsolePanel from '@aziontech/webkit/console-panel'
  import Illustration from '@aziontech/webkit/illustration'
</script>

<template>
  <ConsolePanel
    kind="diagram"
    title="Requests take the shortest path"
    :actions="[{ label: 'See the network', href: '/network', trailing: true }]"
  >
    <template #scene>
      <Illustration
        name="global-network"
        aria-label="Requests routed to the nearest location"
        class="max-w-(--container-lg)"
      />
    </template>
  </ConsolePanel>
</template>
